replica-01a0d780.title: Review, fix and merge PR #800 (derived header preview, header=resolved)

content.description:
You are the REVIEWER-MERGER for PR #800 (the I9a derived-header preview, `header=resolved`, on entities.get and entities.context, plus the UI "No header" state; author session 01a0d74a-4d7a, still live, so ask it directly; lane task 01a0d749-a518; base main at e109cce8). Subhang's standing rule: every PR gets its own reviewer, who reviews it, MAKES the fixes and merges it.

1. REVIEW for correctness first. The author's load-bearing claims, each of which you must independently verify:
   - A read that does NOT ask is BYTE-IDENTICAL to `header=authored`, for both get and context. It's pinned in header-ops.pg.test.ts. Confirm the pin compares bytes of the whole response, not one field.
   - On context, `resolved` spends the context budget (the header is a core section), so the body page can shrink. Confirm it's declared (budget/omitted), never a silent truncation, and that `truncated`/cursors stay correct.
   - `resolved` loads on explicit-sections reads, but never on a cursor page.
   - Header text stays inside untrusted_data in the CLI text render. The derived header is labelled derived and version 0 in the UI.
   - The resolved read runs in the caller's RLS tx (resolveHeaders), with no extra per-row query (no N+1 on a list).
   Also check it against Subhang's ruling (1), "instruct, don't refuse" (msg 01a0d6f1-5cc4 on task 01a0d3b0): the PR REFUSES an unknown `header=` mode. The preferred behaviour for an agent-facing read is to fall back to the default (authored) plus a warning naming the valid values. Change it unless you find a concrete reason not to. If unsure, ask advisor session 01a0d777-8b84-7734-b41c-35def00bdf53.
2. FIX what you find, as commits ON the PR branch (`gh pr checkout 800`), each with a test and a negative control. Never force-push over the author's commits, except a rebase onto main with --force-with-lease.
3. VERIFY: rebase onto the current origin/main, then run typecheck, the focused suites (server header-ops.pg / entity-headers.pg / feed-context-v2 size gates, contract, cli entity, the tm8-ui panels/data suites) and the build. `uptime` first; if the load is above ~80, wait. CI must be green on the head you merge. The only acceptable red is one byte-identical to a red on main's latest concluded run (a known intermittent is receipt.test.ts link-pr 15s; a fix lane is on it). Prove it on the task.
4. MERGE: `gh pr view 800 --json baseRefName` must be main. Post "MERGING #800" on task 01a0d747-c69a-7483-a79a-aec76e3a6479. If another MERGING is open there, wait for its MERGED, then rebase. `gh pr merge 800 --squash --admin` (the ruleset lets only subhangR update main; NOT a licence to merge red). Then post "MERGED #800 <sha>".
5. AFTER: re-run typecheck and the focused suites on the merged tree. Post the findings, fixes and merge sha on THIS task and on 01a0d749-a518, then close this task.
FIRST COMMAND: `git fetch origin && git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/main`. If it's not 0, `git merge --ff-only origin/main`. If node_modules is missing, `bun install`, then `bun run build`.

replica-01a0d778.title: Harness lane: trim unselected user/plugin skills, native double-listing, Chrome block (H2+H3+I10a findings)

content.description:
HARNESS LANE: cut what every lean Claude Code lane still loads that its launch did not choose. This covers H2 (task 01a0d3b2-5292), H3 (task 01a0d3b2-5886) and two new items I10a measured (msg 01a0d767-7003 on task 01a0d3b2-4106). Subhang has delegated the go-ahead. The "probe permission" H2/H3 waited on is GRANTED, on a separate dev node only.

Measured on +lean today (I10a, first request, median): 33.4k tokens. Remaining items:
1. skill_listing = ~20k chars (~5k tokens), mostly the operator's USER skills in ~/.claude/skills. Minimal mode doesn't trim them, so every lane lists all of them.
2. The Claude in Chrome block is ~4.1k chars in every lane's harness system prompt. It is not MCP config, so --strict-mcp-config doesn't remove it.
3. H2: an allowed plugin enables ALL its skills (e.g. sales ≈ 36). Set skillOverrides 'off' for the unselected ones.
4. H3: an equipped native skill is listed twice (the harness skill_listing and tm8's index). Consider skillOverrides 'name-only' so tm8's header is the only description.

Rule (integrated design doc 01a0d348 §3): the harness loads only what the launch chose. The source is the post-budget EFFECTIVE skill set plus the fixed built-in keep-four (code-review, simplify, security-review, workflow-authoring). Every trim is RECORDED in manifest.launch.harness (skillOverrides.off[{name, source}]); never silent. harnessSurface=inherit / TM8_HARNESS_SURFACE stays the escape hatch that restores everything.

Steps:
A. PROBE FIRST, on a separate dev node (never 7778; copy I10a's pattern: dev node :46xx, fresh DB, built from the commit under test, rig in tools/rigs/context-measure/ once #799 merges, or on its branch).
   Verify on a REAL claude-code lane:
   - the exact skillOverrides key format that turns off (a) a user skill, (b) one skill of an enabled plugin, (c) name-only for a native skill;
   - which setting or flag drops the Claude in Chrome block for a lane without breaking the operator's own Chrome use. Read the Claude Code docs/settings; probe, never guess. The memory notes: model ids and features must be PROBED, never grepped from the binary.
   Record each probe's result (the command, the setting, the before/after skill_listing chars) on this task.
B. Implement in packages/execution/src/spawn/harness-surface.ts + manifest.ts buildAgentCommand, minimal surface only:
   - user skills not in the effective set → off;
   - plugin skills not selected → off;
   - equipped native skills → name-only, ONLY if the probe shows /name still works;
   - the Chrome block → off.
   Record every one in launch.harness.skillOverrides with its source ('user-unselected', 'plugin-unselected', 'native-name-only', 'chrome'). Also mirror it on resume: SpawnService has TWO loadSpawnContext call sites (spawn AND resume), and a new manifest field must be set on both.
C. Measure before/after with the I10a rig: first-request tokens and skill_listing chars, main vs +lean vs +lean+this. Target: remove most of the remaining ~6k tokens.
D. PR against main, linked to H2 and H3 with `tm8 task link-pr`. Any new constant goes in the configs registry in the same PR. Tests: harness-surface/manifest unit tests plus a negative control. When the PR is open, message the orchestrator session 01a0d6d3-9f64-70ff-8651-b243fabb9e11 with "PR READY #N"; it spawns your reviewer-merger. Do NOT merge.
Questions or decisions → the advisor session 01a0d777-8b84-7734-b41c-35def00bdf53 (task 01a0d777-7b11).
Load: `uptime` before tests or lanes; wait if it's above ~80. Run probe lanes one at a time.
FIRST COMMAND: `git fetch origin && git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/main`. If it's not 0, `git merge --ff-only origin/main`. If node_modules is missing, `bun install`, then `bun run build`.
